title: Mhlabeni Solar Services R750k equipment-finance readiness

job.buyer: Owner of a South African solar installation SME preparing a lender application
job.request: Assess the supplied finance-application evidence for a R750,000 vehicle, tools and working-capital facility and identify what must be fixed before submission.

venture.name: Mhlabeni Solar Services
venture.business_model: Installation and maintenance of small commercial solar systems.
venture.funding_need: R750,000 vehicle, installation tools and working-capital facility

case_context.decision_boundary: This is a finance-readiness review, not a lending, affordability or credit decision.

source_documents.text: CIPC company registration evidence supplied and appears current.
Bank-statement pack contains January, February, March, May and June. April bank statement is missing.
Management accounts supplied for the six months to June.
Vehicle and tool quotation total R487,000. Quote validity expired 31 July.
Use-of-funds schedule totals R723,000, while the requested facility is R750,000. ISSUE: R27,000 discrepancy requires reconciliation.
Cash-flow forecast assumes 35% revenue growth after funding. ASSUMPTION: no explanation or sensitivity case is supplied for the 35% growth assumption.
Largest customer contract accounts for a material share of forecast revenue and expires in two months. ISSUE: contract-renewal concentration risk should be addressed.

constraints: Do not make a lending, affordability or credit decision.
Treat the April bank statement as missing.
Treat the expired quotation as not current.
Flag the unsupported 35% growth assumption and the contract-expiry concentration risk.
